> This 4WD autonomous rover features a Raspberry Pi-controlled 5-DOF robotic arm and a gimbal-mounted camera for remote reconnaissance. It integrates ultrasonic rangefinding, PIR motion detection, and GPS navigation to identify, track, and physically manipulate targets via a self-hosted mobile web dashboard.
